answer: Each identity must anchor to one blood-donor record at a licensed donation centre: identity is checked each session, donations are spaced by medical rules, and the register allows only one active identity per donor. A lapsed record, or a donor backing two identities, suspends both. Like a trellis training one vine per frame, and a jetty mooring one boat per berth, one donor supports one identity. Sessions begin at dawn and need a living person in the chair, so a farm must recruit one willing, eligible donor per fake, fund travel and screening, and risk a failed check exposing the cluster.
